decisions.reason: As a line extension closely related to the firm's consumer-health and pharmacy business, it fits existing knowledge, manufacturing, and marketing capabilities, so management would expect to learn and improve it rather than exit quickly.

This skin and hair supplement builds on familiar OTC and supplement competences, and although the segment is crowded, the firm's absorptive capacity and portfolio-broadening strategy support retaining it.
Joint-health supplementation is adjacent to the firm's established offer and was given stronger presentation after launch, suggesting the firm can assimilate market feedback and keep developing it.

Despite some novelty in the mushroom-based concept, it still sits within the firm's established supplement range and pharmacy channel, so a large R&D-active firm would more likely refine than withdraw it.

Because this generic blood-pressure product is described as distant from the firm's established offer and already showed a serious market problem in 2018, management would see weaker absorptive fit and higher risk of redeploying resources elsewhere.

The OTC migraine triptan is more distant therapeutically, but it still leverages the firm's pharmaceutical development, regulatory, and pharmacy-channel capabilities, so management would likely give it more time before abandoning it.
